scope: Root read full helper diff, selected component harness, original complete executor/STDOUT, and independent source peer. No whole module import, remote host calls, actual file descriptors or Rust execution.
limitations: One FD at a time and cancellation checks do not hard-preempt a blocking synchronous syscall.
Before/after sequential files do not form an atomic cross-file snapshot.
Target admission and runtime retained-byte/identity results remain separate actual gates.
